nodes.title: Separate environment patch folder
widgets_values: Original 1990s shonen battle-anime fighting-game artwork, with the explosive visual energy and hand-painted cel look of Dragon Ball Z era action animation. Angular expressive eyes and brows, bold economical black ink, sculpted two-tone cel shadows, pronounced but believable athletic anatomy, sharp fabric folds, dramatic foreshortening, bright golden highlights and electric cyan or magenta energy. Original cast only: preserve each supplied person's recognizable face, body build, hairstyle silhouette, clothing and accessories. Increase pointed hair clumps only where compatible with that person; do not replace their hair, outfit or identity with an existing anime character. Strong grounded fighting stances, powerful clear action silhouettes. No copied franchise characters, costumes, symbols or logos. No extra fingers, duplicated props, lettering or watermarks.

Original 1990s shonen battle-anime arcade interface illustration: bold brush ink, hard-edged cel shadows, explosive radial speed lines, hand-painted energy clouds, deep midnight blue and black, vivid gold, electric cyan and hot magenta. Dramatic heroic tournament atmosphere and strong negative space for readable game UI. Original typography and emblems; no copied franchise characters, symbols or logos.

Original hand-painted 1990s anime indoor-environment background, clean architectural ink, rich cel-shaded materials and atmospheric practical lighting. Natural surfaces continue to all four image edges. No decorative border, directional speed lines, radial rays, manga frame, graphic vignette or letterboxing.

nodes.title: Upload venue | clean playable arena
widgets_values: The Yard coworking lobby from the supplied reference photograph: exposed concrete ceiling and columns, silver ductwork and red pipes, long strip lights and hanging black cylindrical pendants, white walls, a rear access ramp with white railings, black reception desk and cubbies, polished pale floor and leafy plants at the edges. Recompose this exact indoor venue as a wide side-on anime fighting arena, retaining recognizable architecture. Keep furniture behind the fight plane and remove all real bystanders and readable signage. This is the sole playable level; it is an indoor venue, not a suburban backyard.

widgets_values:
# One environment

Upload a venue, describe its architecture and keep the floor clear. One paid 2K stage (~$0.072) plus a local source save. Full-bleed artwork without speed-line borders. This is a PARTIAL replacement patch: keep a stage ID already present in the complete base bundle, then merge its accepted stage/source records. To introduce additional venues, enable their slots in the complete main factory.
